title: Distinct kinetic mechanisms of H3K4 methylation catalyzed by MLL3 and MLL4 core complexes.
authors: Zheng, Yongxin; Huang, Yinping; Mencius, Jun; Li, Yanjing; Zhao, Lijie; Luo, Wanting; Chen, Yong; Quan, Shu
one_liner_zh: 该文研究MLL3/MLL4甲基转移酶对组蛋白H3K4的甲基化动力学机制，虽涉及蛋白-底物（组蛋白肽）互作和分子动力学模拟，但对象为酶-组蛋白而非TF-DNA，互作体系非转录因子结合，故与本课题关联度较低。
abstract: The methyltransferases MLL3 and MLL4 primarily catalyze the monomethylation of histone H3 lysine 4 (H3K4) on enhancers to regulate cell-type-specific gene expression and cell fate transition. MLL3 and MLL4 share almost identical binding partners and biochemical activities, but perform specific and nonredundant functions. The features and functions that distinguish MLL3 and MLL4 remain elusive. Here, we characterize the kinetic mechanisms of MLL3 and MLL4 ternary complexes containing the catalytic SET domain from MLL3 or MLL4 (MLL3(SET) or MLL4(SET)), the SPRY domain of ASH2L (ASH2L(SPRY)), and a short fragment of RBBP5 (RBBP5(AS-ABM)) to search for possible explanations. Steady-state kinetic analyses and inhibition studies reveal that the MLL3 complex catalyzes methylation in a random sequential bi-bi mechanism. In contrast, the MLL4 complex adopts an ordered sequential bi-bi mechanism, in which the cofactor S-adenosylmethionine (AdoMet) binds to the enzyme prior to the H3 peptide, and the methylated H3 peptide dissociates from the enzyme before S-adenosylhomocysteine (AdoHcy) detaches after methylation. Substrate-binding assays using fluorescence polarization (FP) confirm that AdoMet binding is a prerequisite for H3 binding for the MLL4 complex but not for the MLL3 complex. Molecular dynamic simulations reveal that the binding of AdoMet exclusively induces conformational constraints on the AdoMet-binding groove and the H3 substrate-binding pocket of MLL4, therefore stabilizing a specific active conformation to ease entry of the substrate H3. The distinct kinetic mechanisms and conformational plasticities provide important insights into the differential functions of MLL3 and MLL4 and may also guide the development of selective inhibitors targeting MLL3 or MLL4.
abstract_zh: 甲基转移酶MLL3和MLL4主要催化增强子上组蛋白H3赖氨酸4（H3K4）的单甲基化，以调控细胞类型特异性基因表达和细胞命运转变。MLL3和MLL4具有几乎相同的结合伙伴和生化活性，但执行特异且非冗余的功能。区分MLL3和MLL4的特征与功能仍不明确。在此，我们表征了包含来自MLL3或MLL4的催化SET结构域（MLL3(SET)或MLL4(SET)）、ASH2L的SPRY结构域（ASH2L(SPRY)）以及RBBP5短片段（RBBP5(AS-ABM)）的MLL3和MLL4三元复合物的动力学机制，以寻找可能的解释。稳态动力学分析和抑制研究表明，MLL3复合物以随机顺序双底物（bi-bi）机制催化甲基化。相比之下，MLL4复合物采用有序顺序双底物机制，其中辅因子S-腺苷甲硫氨酸（AdoMet）在H3肽之前与酶结合，甲基化后的H3肽在S-腺苷同型半胱氨酸（AdoHcy）于甲基化后解离之前从酶上释放。使用荧光偏振（FP）的底物结合实验证实，AdoMet结合是MLL4复合物中H3结合的前提条件，但对MLL3复合物并非如此。分子动力学模拟揭示，AdoMet的结合仅诱导MLL4的AdoMet结合沟槽和H3底物结合口袋产生构象约束，从而稳定特定活性构象以促进底物H3的进入。不同的动力学机制和构象可塑性为MLL3和MLL4的差异功能提供了重要见解，也可能指导针对MLL3或MLL4的选择性抑制剂开发。
